product_metadata.title: HOGOWARE Set of 5 Premium Silicone Lids for Bowls and Food Covers - 6, 8, 10, 12, 13.5" - Brick Red Suction Lid - Reusable - Microwave Airtight Seal Lid Covers for Pots, Pans, Bowls, Cups, Skillets
features: 🥓This AIRTIGHT SEAL LID COVER for Pots, Pans, Bowls, Cups, Skillets is silicone BPA. The lid prevents the moisture from the foods from evaporating while cooking or in transit, so you can enjoy all your food safely. It is also DISHWASHER SAFE, which makes it easy to clean and wash; this cover is built to last!

🥐DON’T LET HEAT RUIN YOUR NEXT MEAL. Silicone Suction Lids are the only dish covers that are made from heat resistant silicone. They will hold their shape, even at extreme temperatures such as deep frying and searing, and stay cool in the microwave or refrigerator.

🍕TIRED OF OVER-HEATING YOUR FAVORITE MEALS? Use this silicone suction lid to create a microwave Airtight Seal. Safely seal anything you can think of in the microwave to ensure that your food stays hot and tasty! Our silicone lids have an airtight seal which keeps moisture and condensation out of your food, keeping it fresh for longer. The bright colors of these silicone lids make them ideal for use on a variety of different sized pots, pans and bowls.

🥮MADE OF TOP-QUALITY SILICONE, it's heat resistant to 450 degrees and can be used on various bowls and pots. The cover is microwave safe, so you can use it in the oven or on the stovetop. It also can be used for extra storage in the fridge, freezer and oven for leftovers. It has a tight seal that keeps food nice and fresh for hours (or more depending on how hot/cold it is.

🧆PERFECT SOLUTION - When you’re in the middle of a quick getaway and it’s too hot to leave the laptop at home, but you don’t want to risk eating your food cold, these silicone lid covers are the solution. They fit over any 6 - 13.5 inch bowls, saucepans, cereal bowls, and more. Not only do they PROVIDE EXTRA PROTECTION for your dishes, but they help everyone else feel comfortable knowing that no one will be able to cheat on their portion sizes when eating with these bad boys around.
